nadia: quick flag from today's keyboard walkthrough: the new Quick Actions gesture (G then A) focuses the action palette, but VoiceOver/NVDA don't get any context that it's interactive. it just lands on a visually dense container. paul_k: repro'd on macOS. focus lands on the palette wrapper (tabindex=0) and VO says 'region' then nothing useful. users need an announcement like 'Quick Actions, 6 items, use arrow keys'. rachel_l: also saw a focus outline problem: the action tiles use a 1px dotted outline on focus which disappears at 2x zoom. contrast of the selected tile label on hover is borderline (#26384F on #EAF3FF ~3.7:1). tony: thanks. quick analysis: palette DOM =
    • ...
. We should add role="menu" or listbox semantics and provide an accessible name. Also add aria-live announcement on open. aria-bot: auto-a11y-scan(quick-actions-palette): failures: 3 (missing accessible name on dialog, poor focus indicator, missing live announcement). scan details: https://ci.internal/a11y/2481234567 nadia: here's a minimal set of fixes I propose: 1) give the palette an accessible label: role="dialog" aria-label="Quick Actions" and set aria-modal="true" while open 2) when opened by gesture, call a11yAnnounce('Quick Actions opened. 6 items. Use arrow keys to navigate.') into aria-live polite 3) switch to roving tabindex for the buttons (only current has tabindex=0) 4) update focus-visible CSS: outline: 3px solid #0B3B82; outline-offset: 3px 5) bump selected text color to #081F40 for contrast ~4.6:1 paul_k: small semantic question: should we use role="menu" + menuitem or role="listbox" + option? menu/menuitem implies action executes immediately; listbox/option is selection-like. rachel_l: Quick Actions are immediate commands (open, duplicate, run eval). menu/menuitem seems semantically correct and maps well to arrow key behavior. ton y: menu also plays nicer with assistive tech expecting Arrow keys. implementation note: menu requires Enter/Space to activate and Arrow keys to move; we'll need to prevent default on Space to avoid scrolling. paul_k: good. also add aria-describedby pointing to a short instructions element for first-time users:
Use arrows to navigate, Enter to run.
aria-bot: suggested automated phrase for live region: "Quick Actions opened. 6 items. Use left and right arrow keys to navigate." Would you like me to auto-insert that into the ticket? (yes/no) nadia: yes please, aria-bot. thanks. aria-bot: created ticket INS-11234 (quick-actions-a11y): failures linked, priority P2, assignee @paul_k, ETA 4 days. patch checklist added. rachel_l: tiny UX nit: for mobile TalkBack, we can't rely on arrow keys. ensure buttons are reachable by standard swipe navigation and that the live announcement still occurs on open. paul_k: will add touch behavior and ensure the dialog receives focus after the open animation (use animationend handler). also will include a small e2e script that verifies aria-live announcement text and role semantics with NVDA/VoiceOver. ton y: CSS snippet I'll add: ``` .quick-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B3B82; outline-offset: 3px; } .quick-actions .selected { color: #081F40; } ``` rachel_l: tests to add to acceptance criteria: - VO/NVDA announce 'Quick Actions opened' and item count on open - ArrowLeft/Right moves focus between items and updates tabindex - Enter activates item and aria-live announces result like 'Duplicated 3 items' - Focus ring visible at 2x zoom on macOS and Windows aria-bot: acceptance criteria saved to INS-11234. a11y-e2e job scheduled. paul_k: i'll push a small branch with menu semantics + aria-live and ping when CI is green. nadia: thanks all. if anyone sees odd rotor/VO phrasing, paste a short clip here. closing for now. :sparkles:
